'''Bareesh''', alternatively known as the '''Bareesh Cartel''' or the '''Bareesh Clan''', was a [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Kajidic/Legends|kajidic]] led by [[Tassaa Bareesh]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. They were part of the [[Hutt Cartel/Legends|Hutt Cartel]] and operated from several [[Planet/Legends|planets]], including [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]], where they had a weapons auction, and on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]], where they were led by [[Bareesh Fenn'ak Torill]]. By the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the Bareesh clan's power had faded significantly, and their throneworld [[Kor Bareesh]] lay in ruins after a supervolcano buried much of the main continent in ash and lava several centuries prior.
